stage: stage 1 - offline retrieval screen (no model generation, no Atlas, dev split only)
question: Does dense masked-question retrieval, fused with the existing BM25 + structural Jaccard ranking by RRF, add structural retrieval relevance over the registered MQL-0010 D0 retriever?

frozen_inputs.mql0010_holdout: NOT READ. Never used for tuning or selection.

embedding.text_field: masked_question (patterns.mask_question; doc side = mql0008_core.build_docs, query side = same function with the target schema from tables.json)
embedding.query_vectors: precomputed dev cache, looked up by sha256 of the exact masked text; no live encoding during the screen

vector_store.dense_top_n_meaning: null = the full eligible pool (resolved to the actual eligible count per query)
vector_store.dense_score_source: CanonicalScorer: float32 dot of the artifact vectors (store retrieves and filters, scores are re-computed backend-independently)

retrieval.candidate_universe: registered view minus the target database (retrieval.Retriever._index_for); forbidden (holdout) DBs abort before indexing
retrieval.bm25: unchanged retrieval.BM25 (k1 1.5, b 0.75) over masked questions, leave-target-DB-out
retrieval.rank: competition ranking on 6-decimal scores over the candidate universe
retrieval.lexical_term: rrf modes: sum of 1/(k + rank) over channels, divided by its maximum over the candidate universe
retrieval.sort: (-score, doc_id); duplicate collapse unchanged (doc_id, repr(mql), normalised question)
retrieval.pair_exclusions: none: no exclusion pairs are registered for the dev split (identical to the historical MQL-0010 dev proxy)
retrieval.selection_for_metrics: top-3 of the ranking (diversify=none) or select_diverse(ranking, 3) (diversify=signature), as in scripts/nl2mql_mql0010/analysis/retrieval_dev_proxy.py; the token budget is not applied

arms.name: R1
arms.role: matched control: RRF rescaling without dense

dropped_from_earlier_proposal: Rx (dense on raw questions): needs a second embedding of the view; deferred unless R2 is strongly below R0

metrics.signature: structure signature = structure.signature(patterns.sql_patterns(gold SQL)) for dev items (labels used for METRICS only); docs: signature(doc patterns)
metrics.hit@3_attainable: PRIMARY. Over the dev items whose gold signature exists in the 2,912-record pool (historical: 679)
metrics.skeleton_hit@3: over the 507 dev items with a corpus MQL: some top-3 doc has the same pipeline stage-operator sequence as the item's own corpus MQL
metrics.triple_change_rate: share of items whose top-3 id set differs from R0 (R0E for the E family)
metrics.paraphrase_twin: arm-independent item flag: some candidate (target DB excluded) has the identical masked text or canonical cosine >= 0.95 AND the item's gold signature
metrics.latency: mean ms per rank_examples call per arm (embedded-local; not production evidence)

anchors.source: outputs/nl2mql_mql0010/dev_evidence/retrieval_dev_proxy.json; the screen aborts if R0/R0E do not reproduce these exactly

gate.G1: R3 - R0 >= +3.0 pp on hit@3_attainable (point estimate)
gate.G2: R3 - R1 on hit@3_attainable: paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
gate.G4: G1, G2 and G3 also hold on the items that are NOT paraphrase twins
gate.pass: G1 and G2 and G3 and G4
gate.if_R1_beats_R0_by_3pp: report that the gain comes from RRF rescaling, not from dense retrieval
gate.on_fail: report 'dense retrieval adds no structural relevance on dev'; no stage 2
gate.on_pass: stage 2 (Atlas execution accuracy, R0 vs R3, new DB-disjoint draw from the 90 build DBs) needs a separate registration and explicit approval
gate.limitation: all screen metrics are structural proxies; they cannot detect non-structural (paraphrase / output-shape) accuracy effects
